title: Generic irreducibility and the exceptional parameter lattice
statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). Let $\varepsilon\in\{0,1\}$, $
u\in\mathbb C$ and $\mathcal W_\varepsilon=\{
u\in\mathbb Z:
u\equiv\varepsilon+1\ (2)\}$.
strategy: Use finite-support K-weight extraction and nonzero ladder arrows; use Fejer means for smooth Fourier density and compact averaging for smooth irreducibility; determine both exceptional subquotient orientations; compute the Killing-normalized Casimir and its rank-one Harish-Chandra generator. AC supplies normalized Haar, AC_omega Fourier inputs, and the Harish-Chandra isomorphism.
